items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains only the interviewer mentioning the name 'Inesuki' (likely a mispronunciation of Ahmet Ertegun) and correcting themselves. The interviewee, Zutty Singleton, does not speak or respond to this mention in the provided text.

ctx.x: How about it? We had a thousand dollars to spend and we went first class. And had this lovely tour. And (Hertigan), I call him Ertegun (Hertigan?) all the time. But everybody.....
Yes, but everybody calls him that. But I never did call him Inesuki. And his wife in California calls him Nicky a lot you know? A lot of them call him Nicky.
